additional_financial_check.source_title: Nscale and Figure Sign Strategic Partnership to Power the Next Generation of Physical AI
additional_financial_check.evidence: Nscale separately describes compute and an equity investment without its amount. Initial GPU deployment is targeted for H2 2027.

limitations: Valuation is a 2025-09-16 historical priced baseline outside the 12-month window.
Complete total capital, latest strategic equity amount, revenue, ARR and paid customer unit count are not disclosed in reviewed primary releases.
Factory and home benchmark results are company-reported, not independently audited.
Third-party July 2026 claim of 1,000th Figure 03 found; originating primary social post not retrieved, so not used as verified scale.
No IPO/SPAC claim was verified in reviewed primary company releases; this is a bounded search, not proof of absence.
slide_corrections: Do not treat Figure's $39B financing valuation or >$1B committed Series C as a new 2026 round.
Do not label Nscale's $3.5B compute commitment as Figure funding.
Do not equate BotQ output, annual capacity plans, or cars supported at BMW with paid robot deliveries.

handoff.method: Live web search, primary-page reading, dated spot checks
handoff.challenge: Distinguishing capital commitments, compute contracts, manufacturing output and customer deployments
handoff.parent_instruction: Keep unknown capital blank; retain inequality and company-reported labels.
